join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: phase

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: cmd

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: phase
join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.detail: === Phase 4 [T] quiet apt on the node (the baseline stalls on the dpkg lock otherwise; unmasked in phase 14) ===

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: phase
join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.detail: === Phase 5 [A] host baseline, narrowed to the node — run detached if the session may drop: it apt-upgrades and reboot-waves ===

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.detail: cd '<repo>/ops/ansible' && OBJC_DISABLE_INITIALIZE_FORK_SAFETY=YES ../scripts/with-aws default -- ../scripts/ansible-preflight.sh -i inventory/mgmt-hosts.ini -i inventory/mgmt-hosts-mesh.ini mgmt-host-baseline.yml -e target=zagros_hosts -e site_id=zagros -l node-x

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: phase
join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.detail: === Phase 6 [A] WireGuard kernel modules, first pass — its wt0 check fails before enrolment (wt0 absent); expected, phase 11 re-runs it. Any other failure stops the run ===

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.detail: cd '<repo>/ops/ansible' && log=$(mktemp) && if OBJC_DISABLE_INITIALIZE_FORK_SAFETY=YES ../scripts/with-aws default -- ../scripts/ansible-preflight.sh -i inventory/mgmt-hosts.ini -i inventory/mgmt-hosts-mesh.ini wireguard-kmod.yml -e target=zagros_hosts -l node-x 2>&1 | tee "$log"; then rm -f "$log"; elif awk '/^TASK \[/{t=$0} /^fatal:/{n++; if (t !~ /verify wt0 is kernelspace wireguard/) bad=1} END{exit !(n>0 && !bad)}' "$log" && grep -q 'wt0.*does not exist' "$log"; then rm -f "$log"; echo '>> wireguard-kmod: the wt0 check failed before enrolment (wt0 absent) — expected; phase 11 re-runs it for changed=0'; else echo "!! wireguard-kmod failed on something other than the pre-enrolment wt0 check — output kept in $log"; exit 1; fi

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: phase
join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.detail: === Phase 7 [GATE] the CA this site trusts is its own, not the shared dev root (silence puts a production node on the dev CA) ===

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.detail: python3 '<repo>/ops/scripts/standup-config-preflight.py' zagros_hosts --before-enrolment && ! grep -rqE 'ca_id:[[:space:]]*"?[a-z]+-goat-ca-' '<repo>/ops/ansible/group_vars/zagros_hosts/' || { echo 'group_vars/zagros_hosts names the unnamed default CA (<mode>-goat-ca-<date>); a site node trusts its goatnet CA'; exit 1; }

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: phase
join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.detail: === Phase 8 [GATE] the site declares where its nodes enrol (mesh_enrollment_url): phase 10 mints the setup key and enrols the node, and refuses before any key exists without it ===

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.detail: grep -rqsE '^mesh_enrollment_url:[[:space:]]*\"?https://' '<repo>/ops/ansible/group_vars/zagros_hosts/' '<repo>/ops/ansible/group_vars/zagros_hosts/' || { echo 'set mesh_enrollment_url in group_vars/zagros_hosts/vars.yml: https://<the enrolment name of zagros>:443 (it resolves to the relays) or :8443 (it resolves to the host itself)'; exit 1; }

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: phase
join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.detail: === Phase 9 [GATE] enrollment preflight on the node (clock skew, a stale wt0, an unreachable apex — each turns enrolment into a hang); no setup key is sent: phase 10 mints it where it is used ===

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.detail: { printf 'export NETBIRD_MANAGEMENT_URL=%q\n' 'https://netbird.example.net'; cat '<repo>/ops/preflight-enrollment.sh'; } | ssh operator@192.0.2.9 'bash -s -- --key-at-enrolment'

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: phase
join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.detail: === Phase 10 [A] enrol the node: a single-use, one-hour setup key minted on the first host of zagros_hosts (where the NetBird database is), with the groups that host's peer holds, handed to netbird up through a 0600 file on the node and removed; the key never reaches this machine ===

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.detail: cd '<repo>/ops/ansible' && OBJC_DISABLE_INITIALIZE_FORK_SAFETY=YES ../scripts/with-aws default -- ../scripts/ansible-preflight.sh -i inventory/mgmt-hosts.ini -i inventory/mgmt-hosts-mesh.ini mesh-enroll-host.yml -e target=zagros_hosts -l node-x -e mesh_enroll_mint_group=zagros_hosts -e mesh_enroll_groups_from_peer=true -e mesh_ips_out='<home>/.goat/state/join-node-zagros-node-x-mesh-ips.json'

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: phase
join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.detail: === Phase 10 [GATE] the node is on the kernel ACL plane, not only "Connected": netbird's interface is the kernel's, and `table ip netbird` is loaded ===

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.detail: ssh operator@192.0.2.9 'sudo netbird status | grep -q "Interface type: Kernel" && sudo nft list tables | grep -qx "table ip netbird"'

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: phase

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: cmd

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: phase
join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.detail: === Phase 13 [A] [core, founder site] site-bootstrap on the node (intra_site_pair: the A→B streaming standby is phase 6A of the play) ===

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.detail: cd '<repo>/ops/ansible' && OBJC_DISABLE_INITIALIZE_FORK_SAFETY=YES ../scripts/with-aws default -- ../scripts/ansible-preflight.sh -i inventory/mgmt-hosts.ini -i inventory/mgmt-hosts-mesh.ini -l node-x site-bootstrap.yml -e site_id=zagros -e bootstrap_owner_email="$OWNER_EMAIL" -e 'postgres_superuser_password={{ lookup("env", "ZAGROS_PG_PASS") }}' -e 'netbird_encryption_key={{ lookup("env", "ZAGROS_NB_ENCKEY") }}' -e 'pgbackrest_cipher_pass={{ lookup("env", "ZAGROS_BKP_KEY") }}'

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: phase
join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.detail: === Phase 14 [T] unmask and start the apt timers now that the node is finished (over the mesh: the node's address is the one phase 10 recorded) ===

join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/zagros core mesh.detail: cd '<repo>/ops/ansible' && t=$(python3 ../scripts/inventory-hosts.py zagros_hosts --inventory inventory/mgmt-hosts-mesh.ini --ssh-target --user operator --host node-x) && [ -n "$t" ] || { echo 'inventory/mgmt-hosts-mesh.ini gives node-x no mesh address under [zagros_hosts]; phase 10 records it'; exit 1; }; ssh "$t" 'sudo systemctl unmask apt-daily.timer apt-daily-upgrade.timer && sudo systemctl enable --now apt-daily.timer apt-daily-upgrade.timer'

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: if ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 operator@192.0.2.9 sudo -n true; then echo '>> operator@192.0.2.9: key auth and NOPASSWD sudo already work — seed skipped'; else '<repo>/ops/scripts/with-secrets' '<repo>/ops/scripts/seed-ssh-key.sh' operator@192.0.2.9 GAMMA_NODE_PASS; fi

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: python3 '<repo>/ops/scripts/standup-config-preflight.py' gamma_hosts --before-enrolment

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: phase
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: === Phase 3 [GATE] the node's clock, read-only, before anything on it changes: synchronized to an outside reference and within the offset budget (JOIN_NODE_CLOCK_BUDGET_MS, default 250 ms of the router's 500 ms limit) ===

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: python3 '<repo>/ops/scripts/join-node-clock-check.py' node-x operator@192.0.2.9

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: phase
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: === Phase 3 [T] the site's secrets: the values every site shares (newsite-secrets.sh --cluster-json: NetBird's datastore key, the replicator, the relay secret, Ory's network id, the Kratos cipher, the Hydra system secret) are taken from alpha's, as references or under a value store; newsite-secrets.sh mints the site's own; each shared value is compared with the founder's, by digest. Nothing is overwritten: a joiner value that differs is refused (GB-353) ===

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: python3 '<repo>/ops/scripts/join-site-secrets.py' gamma --founder alpha

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: phase
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: === Phase 4 [T] quiet apt on the node (the baseline stalls on the dpkg lock otherwise; unmasked in phase 14) ===

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: ssh operator@192.0.2.9 'sudo systemctl mask --now apt-daily.timer apt-daily-upgrade.timer'

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: phase
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: === Phase 5 [A] host baseline, narrowed to the node — run detached if the session may drop: it apt-upgrades and reboot-waves ===

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: cd '<repo>/ops/ansible' && OBJC_DISABLE_INITIALIZE_FORK_SAFETY=YES ../scripts/with-aws zagros-example -- ../scripts/ansible-preflight.sh -i inventory/mgmt-hosts.ini -i inventory/mgmt-hosts-mesh.ini mgmt-host-baseline.yml -e target=gamma_hosts -e site_id=gamma -l node-x

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: phase
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: === Phase 6 [A] WireGuard kernel modules, first pass — its wt0 check fails before enrolment (wt0 absent); expected, phase 11 re-runs it. Any other failure stops the run ===

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: cd '<repo>/ops/ansible' && log=$(mktemp) && if OBJC_DISABLE_INITIALIZE_FORK_SAFETY=YES ../scripts/with-aws zagros-example -- ../scripts/ansible-preflight.sh -i inventory/mgmt-hosts.ini -i inventory/mgmt-hosts-mesh.ini wireguard-kmod.yml -e target=gamma_hosts -l node-x 2>&1 | tee "$log"; then rm -f "$log"; elif awk '/^TASK \[/{t=$0} /^fatal:/{n++; if (t !~ /verify wt0 is kernelspace wireguard/) bad=1} END{exit !(n>0 && !bad)}' "$log" && grep -q 'wt0.*does not exist' "$log"; then rm -f "$log"; echo '>> wireguard-kmod: the wt0 check failed before enrolment (wt0 absent) — expected; phase 11 re-runs it for changed=0'; else echo "!! wireguard-kmod failed on something other than the pre-enrolment wt0 check — output kept in $log"; exit 1; fi

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: phase
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: === Phase 7 [GATE] the CA this site trusts is its own, not the shared dev root (silence puts a production node on the dev CA) ===

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: python3 '<repo>/ops/scripts/standup-config-preflight.py' gamma_hosts --before-enrolment && ! grep -rqE 'ca_id:[[:space:]]*"?[a-z]+-goat-ca-' '<repo>/ops/ansible/group_vars/gamma_hosts/' || { echo 'group_vars/gamma_hosts names the unnamed default CA (<mode>-goat-ca-<date>); a site node trusts its goatnet CA'; exit 1; }

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: phase
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: === Phase 8 [GATE] the site declares where its nodes enrol (mesh_enrollment_url): phase 10 mints the setup key and enrols the node, and refuses before any key exists without it ===

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: grep -rqsE '^mesh_enrollment_url:[[:space:]]*\"?https://' '<repo>/ops/ansible/group_vars/gamma_hosts/' '<repo>/ops/ansible/group_vars/gamma_hosts/' || { echo 'set mesh_enrollment_url in group_vars/gamma_hosts/vars.yml: https://<the enrolment name of alpha>:443 (it resolves to the relays) or :8443 (it resolves to the host itself)'; exit 1; }

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: phase
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: === Phase 9 [GATE] enrollment preflight on the node (clock skew, a stale wt0, an unreachable apex — each turns enrolment into a hang); no setup key is sent: phase 10 mints it where it is used ===

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: { printf 'export NETBIRD_MANAGEMENT_URL=%q\n' 'https://netbird.zagros.example.org'; cat '<repo>/ops/preflight-enrollment.sh'; } | ssh operator@192.0.2.9 'bash -s -- --key-at-enrolment'

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: phase
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: === Phase 10 [A] enrol the node: a single-use, one-hour setup key minted on the first host of alpha_hosts (where the NetBird database is), with the groups that host's peer holds, handed to netbird up through a 0600 file on the node and removed; the key never reaches this machine ===

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: cd '<repo>/ops/ansible' && OBJC_DISABLE_INITIALIZE_FORK_SAFETY=YES ../scripts/with-aws zagros-example -- ../scripts/ansible-preflight.sh -i inventory/mgmt-hosts.ini -i inventory/mgmt-hosts-mesh.ini mesh-enroll-host.yml -e target=gamma_hosts -l node-x -e mesh_enroll_mint_group=alpha_hosts -e mesh_enroll_groups_from_peer=true -e mesh_ips_out='<home>/.goat/state/join-node-gamma-node-x-mesh-ips.json'

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: phase

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: ssh operator@192.0.2.9 'sudo netbird status | grep -q "Interface type: Kernel" && sudo nft list tables | grep -qx "table ip netbird"'

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: phase

join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.name: cmd
join-node zagros/gamma core mesh.detail: cd '<repo>/ops/ansible' && OBJC_DISABLE_INITIALIZE_FORK_SAFETY=YES ../scripts/with-aws zagros-example -- ../scripts/ansible-preflight.sh -i inventory/mgmt-hosts.ini -i inventory/mgmt-hosts-mesh.ini wireguard-kmod.yml -e target=gamma_hosts -l node-x

standup zagros internet.name: cmd
standup zagros internet.detail: handbook §'Phase 11' has the exact block.
